severity.description: How much the report hurts: critical stops work, major breaks a feature, minor is an annoyance, question is not a defect

area.description: The part of the product the report belongs to, in one or two words

summary.description: The report in one sentence, as a maintainer would restate it

labels.description: Labels to put on the issue, taken from the allowed list only

needs_info.description: True when the report cannot be acted on before the reporter answers a question

question.description: The one question to ask the reporter; present only when needs_info is true
